# Tests — Deep Context

## Framework
- **Unit/Integration:** bun:test
- **E2E:** @playwright/test with custom subprocess test server
- **Snapshot:** bun:test snapshots for plist/systemd generation
- **Commands:** `bun test` (unit+integration), `bunx playwright test` (e2e)

## Directory Layout
```
tests/
  unit/           ~25 files — pure logic, no I/O (or controlled tmpdir I/O)
  integration/    4 files — live HTTP/WebSocket server tests
  snapshot/       2 files — bun:test snapshot tests
  e2e/            5 files — Playwright browser tests + helpers
```

## Integration Tests

| File | Covers |
|------|--------|
| take-control.test.ts | Full WS take-control protocol with mock tmux |
| concurrent-pty-viewer.test.ts | Concurrent conflicts, displacement+reconnect, PTY crash, leak test |
| rate-limit.test.ts | HTTP 429 rate limiting via real server |
| ralph-aggregation.test.ts | GET /api/ralph aggregation, machineName field |
| api.test.ts | Full REST API: sessions (sort order), create (cmd passthrough, TOCTOU race via onBeforeCreate hook), kill (side-effect verification), resize (clamped value assertions), backend toggle |

Shared utility: `pty-test-helpers.ts` — in-process test server with injectable tmux mocks.

## Snapshot Tests
- plist.test.ts: renderPlist env vars, args, XML escaping
- systemd.test.ts: renderSystemdUnit ExecStart quoting, env vars

## E2E Tests (Playwright)

|------|--------|-----------|
| smoke.e2e.ts | PWA loads, /api/info returns metadata | All |
| terminal.e2e.ts | Session -> terminal view, WS connects | Mobile + desktop |

| grid.e2e.ts | Desktop grid navigation, suspend/resume | Desktop |

E2E helpers: `helpers.ts` (startTestServer, viewport presets), `test-server.ts` (child process with mock tmux stubs).

## Coverage Assessment

**Well-covered:** Grid logic, take-control state machine, validation (+ fuzzing), ralph log parsing (lifecycle, phases, iterations), reconnect hydration, escaping, rate limiting, worktree ops, plan parsing/mutation, CSP nonce, peer validation.

**Gaps:**
- No auth middleware unit tests
- No WS terminal streaming tests
- E2E tests have reliability issues (failed screenshots for reconnect.e2e.ts, grid.e2e.ts)
- No `?aggregate=true` test with real peer
- No tests for Tailscale CORS origin recovery logic
